## Run the corpus

The corpus is language-neutral JSON. Load `manifest.json`, run each fixture it names through
your evaluator, and compare against `expected`. The numbered algorithm your evaluator must
implement is section 9 of the specification.

A reference runner lives in the standard repository at `packages/oar-ref`:

```bash
npx @openagentrules/oar-ref ./conformance
```

## Editing

The prose, the schemas, the observation vocabulary, and every fixture are **hand-authored
here**. Two files inside this tree are generated because they are projected from it:
`1.1/conformance/manifest.json` and `clause-index.json`.

A change lands the clause, the schema edit, and at least one fixture together — see
[`GOVERNANCE.md`](GOVERNANCE.md).
